investigations.title: Hardcoded Admin Credentials in Source Code
investigations.question: Are admin credentials hardcoded in source files committed to the repository?
investigations.focus: CWE-798: Find all hardcoded credentials, assess exposure risk, verify if .env is gitignored

investigations.title: Broken Access Control — RLS Policy Audit
investigations.question: Do RLS policies properly restrict access? Can any authenticated user perform admin operations?
investigations.focus: CWE-862: Audit all RLS policies, check for role-based access control gaps, verify admin guard completeness

investigations.title: SSRF in Fragrantica Edge Function
investigations.question: Can the edge function be tricked into making requests to internal or arbitrary URLs?
investigations.focus: CWE-918: Trace URL/query flow from client to edge function fetch(), check for SSRF mitigations

investigations.title: Cleartext Transmission of Tracking Data
investigations.question: Is sensitive tracking data (IP, fingerprint) transmitted over insecure channels?
investigations.focus: CWE-319: Check all external API calls for HTTPS, trace data flow from collection to storage

investigations.title: Credential Exposure via Environment Variables
investigations.question: Are Supabase credentials properly protected? Is the anon key the only key exposed to clients?
investigations.focus: CWE-798/CWE-922: Verify env var handling, check for service role key exposure, audit .gitignore

investigations.title: XSS via WhatsApp Message Injection
investigations.question: Can user-controlled input in the WhatsApp message builder lead to injection attacks?
investigations.focus: XSS/Injection: Trace user name and product data through message template to wa.me URL
